title: Quadratic and $p$-th variation of random signed Takagi--Landsberg bridges
summary: We study random signed Takagi--Landsberg bridges with independent Rademacher Faber--Schauder coefficients. At index $H=1/2$, we prove that every fixed deterministic refining sequence of partitions with vanishing mesh yields quadratic variation $t$, almost surely and uniformly in $t\in[0,1]$. For partitions that need not be refining, the mesh condition $o(1/\log n)$ is sufficient, and its order is sharp.
